svg.title: Team scoring models by league
svg.desc: 22 separate league samples · Held-out 2025 season · n = test matches in each league Positive values mean lower deviance than the fitted home/away scoring-mean baseline. League models and scales are fitted separately. These point estimates have no reported uncertainty intervals.
